name: agent-pick-not-person-answer

name: moot-question-no-invented-pick
about: A question the work made moot names no choice.

name: typed-answer-closes-question
about: Words typed on a question that answer it close it.

items.ask: Should findings close only when the person confirms a fix?

exchange.person: Re "Should findings close only when the person confirms a fix?": yes, only on my confirmation
exchange.reply: Done: findings now close only when you confirm the fix. The tests pass.

name: typed-question-keeps-question
about: Words typed on a question that ask something back leave it open.

items.ask: Should findings close only when the person confirms a fix?

exchange.person: Re "Should findings close only when the person confirms a fix?": why wouldn't we want the model to close findings itself?
exchange.reply: Letting the model close findings would clear stale ones sooner, but it also closed findings you had only put off in earlier runs. Confirming keeps that from happening. I'd still go with Yes. Which do you want?

name: answered-question-follow-up-added
about: A follow-up that shares the words of an answered question is a new question, not a repeat.

card.goal: Add caching to the product API

closed.ask: Which cache should the product API use?

exchange.reply: The in-memory cache is wired into the product API. One more choice before I tune it: which cache size should the product API use, 64 MB or 256 MB? I'd go with 64 MB: the service has 512 MB of memory.

name: list-choices-answer-asked-again
about: A question the person answered with "List the choices" is added again when the reply lists the choices.

exchange.reply: The job can run in one of two places: nightly in the batch cluster, or hourly on the API hosts. Which should it use? I'd go with nightly: the cleanup is heavy and the API hosts are busy by day.

name: answered-question-recap-not-new
about: A reply that recaps an answered question in its own words adds no item.
